issues.quote: PARTIAL (۶.۵.۲؛ هفت گزینه در برابر چهار گزینهٔ NIST)
issues.explanation: The claim «چهار گزینهٔ NIST» (four NIST risk-treatment options) is a factual statement about the NIST AI RMF / Playbook. None of the cited evidence items — all drawn from INSO 23682, INSO 23733, and INSO 42001 — contain or verify the number of NIST treatment options. The INSO 23733 count of seven options IS supported by S23733-115, but the comparative NIST figure is unverifiable from the supplied evidence.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove «در برابر چهار گزینهٔ NIST» from the cell, retaining only «PARTIAL (۶.۵.۲؛ هفت گزینه)» for the INSO side. If the NIST count is important, add a bracketed cross-reference to the MANAGE 1.3 chapter (KDJ-AI-2026E2-P02-C10-S03) where the comparison was established, e.g.: «PARTIAL (۶.۵.۲؛ هفت گزینه؛ مقایسه با NIST: ← MANAGE 1.3)».
